marketing_description: The VELUX® Fixed Skylight, part number FS C01 2004S, from the FS Series, fits a rough opening of 21 in width by 26‑7/8 in height and features a gray/white frame. It includes a white room‑darkening shade that operates on solar power, providing daylight control without additional wiring. This fixed skylight design offers a reliable solution for new construction and retrofit projects.
